title: Etale heart bounds control cohomological ranges on pro-etale complexes of etale origin
statement:
Let $f:X	o Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $B$ be a finite commutative ring with its discrete topology. Use constant coefficient sheaves, ordinary etale and pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], site comparison $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and ordinary total derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $N\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $R^qf_{\mathrm{et},*}M=0$ for every etale sheaf $M$ of $B$-modules and every integer $q\geq0$ with $q>N$. Let $a\leq b$ be integers and let $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ be bounded. Put $C=
u_X^*L$ and assume $\mathcal H^r(C)=0$ for $r
otin[a,b]$, using the cohomology of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $\mathcal H^r(L)=0$ for $r
otin[a,b]$ and
$$\mathcal H^i(Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C)=0\quad	ext{for }i
otin[a,b+N].$$
If $N<0$, both $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L$ and $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C$ are zero. No constructibility or Tor amplitude is assumed for $L$, and no cohomological bound on arbitrary pro-etale sheaves is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08J5, remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle (successive cohomology triangles); Tag 05TC, lemma-negative-vanishing. Combined with proetale.tex Tag 09A6, lemma-morphism-comparison, and exact fully faithful comparison pullback. This extracts old proof step 6, using the existing lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude rather than duplicating its general finite-truncation statement.

proof.text:
For either $T=X$ or $T=Y$, comparison inverse image on $B$-modules is exact and fully faithful by [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules]. It is applied termwise on derived categories by [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Exactness preserves the kernels, images and quotients defining cohomology [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], so $\mathcal H^r(
u_T^*K)\cong
u_T^*\mathcal H^r(K)$. It also reflects zero objects: if $
u_T^*M=0$, faithfulness applied to $1_M$ and $0$ gives $1_M=0$, hence $M=0$. Apply this with $T=X$ and $K=L$ to deduce $\mathcal H^r(L)=0$ outside $[a,b]$.

source.place: Tag 099T, lemma-fully-faithful; exact module inverse image and the termwise cohomology calculation

proof.text: Put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ and $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$. These are Grothendieck abelian categories admitting K-injective resolutions by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], applied in the small-site universe of the given module categories. The functor $f_{\mathrm{et},*}:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ is additive and left exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. Its ordinary total right derived functor $T=Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}$ is triangulated and commutes with all integer shifts by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. Its restriction to bounded-below objects is the derived direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]: both are computed by applying $f_{\mathrm{et},*}$ to a K-injective resolution. Thus the heart cohomology of $T(M[0])$ is exactly the $R^qf_{\mathrm{et},*}M$ in the hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 05SE, proposition-derived-functor (exactness); 05SU, lemma-derived-shift; ordinary K-injective computation

proof.text: Suppose $N\geq0$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing] to $f_{\mathrm{et},*}$ and $M[0]$: $\mathcal H^q(T(M[0]))=0$ for $q<0$. For $q>N$, we have $q\geq0$, so the assumed higher-direct-image bound gives the remaining vanishing. Hence every object of the heart is sent into $[0,N]$.

source.place: Tag 05TC, lemma-negative-vanishing (1), applied to a sheaf in degree zero

proof.text: Still with $N\geq0$, apply [lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude] to the triangulated functor $T$ of Step 2, the class $\mathcal S$ of all objects of $\mathcal A$, and $c=0$, $d=N$. The class contains zero and is closed under isomorphism; the heart hypothesis is Step 3, and $L$ has range $[a,b]$ by Step 1. The lemma gives $\mathcal H^i(Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L)=0$ outside $[a+0,b+N]=[a,b+N]$. This uses only the finite cohomology tower of the bounded input, with no completeness or infinite-product assumption.

source.place: Tag 08J5, remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle: finite successive-cohomology devissage, as encapsulated by the cited amplitude lemma

proof.text: Suppose instead $N<0$. Taking $q=0>N$ in the hypothesis gives $R^0f_{\mathrm{et},*}M=0$ for every $M\in\mathcal A$. The natural identification $R^0v\cong v$ of [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor], applied to the additive left exact functor of Step 2, therefore gives $f_{\mathrm{et},*}M=0$ for every $M$. Choose a K-injective resolution of $L$. In the resolution formula for derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], every term of its direct image is now zero. That complex is zero, so $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L=0$.

source.place: Tags 015B, lemma-higher-derived-functors (2), and 05TE, lemma-right-derived-delta-functor; K-injective formula for ordinary derived direct image

proof.text:
Since $L$ is bounded it is bounded below. Apply [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison] with the discrete commutative ring $B$ and the qcqs morphism $f$ to obtain $
u_Y^*Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L\cong Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}
u_X^*L=Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C$. In the case $N\geq0$, Step 1 at $Y$ identifies the cohomology of the left side with $
u_Y^*\mathcal H^i(Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L)$, which is zero outside $[a,b+N]$ by Step 4. In the case $N<0$, Step 5 makes the left side zero (an additive exact functor preserves zero), so $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C=0$ as well. A zero object has zero cohomology in every degree, which implies the stated interval assertion even if $b+N<a$. The comparison has been used only on the bounded-below etale complex $L$.

The delivery has one commit, the item plus its report, and zero new nodes. In side-live the item is still unsplit, it is not in the dropped list and no repair note names it; NU's re-split of its parent created it to carry old step 6. The statement is unchanged. Step 1: the comparison pullback ν^* is exact, so it commutes with cohomology, and it is faithful, so it reflects zero; this gives L range [a,b]. Step 2: Grothendieck categories and K-injectives (prop-pur), f_* left exact, the unbounded RF triangulated, and on D^+ it agrees with def-weil-pbc-direct-image. Step 3: negative vanishing plus the hypothesis put heart objects in [0,N]. Step 4: lem-pur-bounded-heart-amplitude with S = all objects and c=0, d=N gives [a,b+N]. Step 5: when N<0, q=0 together with R^0v≅v gives f_*=0, so Rf_*L=0; consistent, since this forces X empty or B=0. Step 6: f qcqs and L bounded, hence D^+, so sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison applies; Step 1 at Y moves the cohomology across, and the empty-interval case holds. The coefficient category (Cont(π0,B) versus ν^*B for finite B) is the DAG's standing identification; the base-change morphism is the ordinary K-injective direct image. Edge cases checked: a=b, N=0, N<0, L=0, b+N<a. No duplicate: the hits for 'b+N]' are Tor-amplitude or condensed nodes, or the item's own citers and analogues. All 8 declared tool uses are generic black boxes, and the definition unit has no route of its own, so they are accepted. No SGA. No changes.
